title: Funds can be redirected
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  ```rust  #[account(mut)]     pub user_token_account: Account<'info, TokenAccount> ```  In `programs/solver-fund-pool-anchor/src/instructions/borrow.rs:142-143`, the `user_token_account` is only required to be writable; the program never checks whether `owner == user.key()`. The signed message also omits the `user_token_account`, and the contract does not validate that `user_token_account.owner` equals `user`, nor that it is the user’s associated token account (ATA).
